prompt: A border fort guarding the pass against the settlement to the north.

card.name: Pass Border Fort

site.text: A border fort set across a mountain pass, blocking the route north toward the neighbouring settlement.

style.text: Sturdy, practical stone military look: stone brick and cobblestone walls, dark timber, banners, torch and lantern lighting.

purpose.text: Guard the pass against the settlement to the north; a garrisoned border defence.

card.interpretation: I read this as a medium fortress built across a mountain pass, facing north toward the rival settlement. Style is a plain medieval military look, purpose is a garrisoned border defence, and there is no backstory since you gave none. The program is a gate, wall towers, a keep, barracks and the support buildings a garrison needs.
assumptions: Medieval stone style since none was named.
Existing terrain with a pass is used; the fort faces north.

program.notes: Fortified keep on the south side of the pass, overlooking the wall and the northern approach.
Portcullis gate closing the pass road, facing north.
Flank the wall on each side of the pass with archer platforms.
Bunks, chests for gear, behind the wall.
Repairs weapons and armour; anvil and grindstone.
Soldiers' canteen with long tables and hearth.
